title: Share past sleep and keep collecting
patient_summary: Dr. Rivera wants to check whether your sleep changes before your episodes. This test uses only sleep from your Fitbit and your episode log from 2026-10-01 to 2026-12-01. This includes your past data from 2026-10-01 to 2026-11-15, which will be shared as soon as you approve, and new data collected from then until 2026-12-01. Nothing else is shared. You can pause or stop at any time.
